label: Claude Pro
limits: "Every plan has usage limits that reset on a rolling five-hour session window, and paid plans add weekly limits on top." "Pro gives you at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free." "Your activity across Claude on web, desktop, mobile, and Claude Code all draws from the same pool."

label: Claude Max 5x
limits: "Max gives you 5x or 20x more usage per 5-hour session than Pro." Help center: "five times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance"; "Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours." "Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".

label: Claude Max 20x
limits: Help center: "20 times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance"; "Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours." "Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".

label: ChatGPT Plus
limits: Local messages per five-hour period (estimates, 'not fixed message limits'): GPT-6 Astra 5-45, GPT-6.1 Sol 15-160, GPT-6 Sol 15-150, GPT-6 Luna 350-3,000. "Local messages and cloud chats share your plan's usage allowance. Weekly limits may also apply." Fast mode uses included usage at 2.5x.

limits: "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." Help center: "Pro 200 includes more usage than Pro 100." Weekly limits apply. At launch (2026-04-09) OpenAI said: "Pro $100 unlocks 5x higher usage than Plus" (secondary report of the launch statement).

label: ChatGPT Pro 200
limits: "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." "Pro 200 includes more usage than Pro 100." "New subscriptions that aren't eligible for grandfathering include a lower usage allowance than previously offered with Pro 200."

label: ChatGPT Pro 500
limits: "Pro 500 offers the highest included usage of the three plans." "Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit." Ultrafast "uses your plan's included usage first at 8x the Standard rate for the selected model, then draws from your credit balance at 6x the Standard credit rate".

label: OpenCode Go
limits: "Estimated requests per 5 hours and monthly usage limits by model", e.g. Kimi K3: 110 req/5h, $15 monthly usage; Kimi K2.7 Code 1,350 / $60; MiniMax M3 3,200 / $60; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 34,670 / $80.
